dialog.dropzoneHint: Drop an Excel file here, or click to choose one
dialog.dropzoneFormats: .xlsx, .xls or .csv — up to {{maxMb}} MB and {{maxCells}} filled cells
dialog.chooseAnother: Click or drop to choose a different file
dialog.note: Learners see a read-only copy of every tab and can download the original file. Formulas show their saved values; charts and pictures aren’t shown.
dialog.createFailed: Couldn’t add the spreadsheet slide. Please try again.
dialog.uploadFailed: Couldn’t upload the original file. Please try again.

errors.empty: This file has no filled cells.
errors.unsupportedType: Choose an Excel (.xlsx or .xls) or CSV file.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is {{size}} MB. The limit is {{max}} MB.
errors.tooManyTabs: This workbook has {{tabs}} tabs. The limit is {{max}}.
errors.tooManyCells: This workbook has {{cells}} filled cells. The limit is {{max}}. Remove unused sheets or rows and try again.
errors.tabTooLarge: The tab “{{tab}}” spans {{cells}} cells (rows × columns). The limit is {{max}}. Delete stray content far below or to the right and try again.
errors.dataTooLarge: This workbook is too large to show on a slide. Remove unused sheets or rows and try again.
errors.unreadable: We couldn’t read this file. Save it again in Excel as .xlsx and try again.

editor.heading: Spreadsheet
editor.statusDraft: Draft — learners can’t see this spreadsheet until you publish.
editor.statusUnsync: Saved changes are not live yet — Publish to share them.
editor.statusUnsaved: Unsaved changes — use Save Draft or Publish above.
editor.replaced: File replaced. Use Save Draft or Publish to keep it.
editor.downloadFailed: Couldn’t get the original file. Please try again.
editor.allowDownload: Let learners download the original file
editor.noFile: The original file wasn’t kept, so learners only see the grid.
editor.invalid: This spreadsheet slide has no readable data. Replace the file to fix it.
